rationale.summary: No blockers found. All issues are either structural design gaps (not bugs) or cosmetic. The organism ran correctly today — it correctly rejected losers and its inability to capture winners was due to well-understood structural limitations in the confidence formula and regime detection. No code change is justified by 2 days of evidence.
why_not_strategy_tweak: The confidence gate is working as designed. Lowering it from 0.25 to 0.15 would have produced 2 winners + 3 losers over 2 days — no improvement.
The inverse ETF problem (SH/PSQ always eff_conf=0.00) is a confidence FORMULA issue, not a gate threshold issue. Changing the gate doesn't help.
The regime detector lag is a known limitation but it did NOT cause today's zero-trade outcome — the primary blocker was confidence scores, not regime.
Two data points (3/11 + 3/12) are insufficient to justify any strategy parameter change.
why_not_non_strategy_fix: Trade forensic fields are wired correctly — they'll populate on the next trade. No fix needed.
realized_trades DB gap is a design gap, not a bug. Fixing it tonight adds risk for no immediate benefit.
Alpaca connection retry would be nice-to-have but errors are post-close and self-recovering.
Brain manifest sync gap (142 vs 158) will auto-correct on next brain save. Not urgent.

what_the_evidence_actually_shows.forensic_fields: FULLY WIRED in code since C2 patch (2026-03-09). Not exercised live due to 2 consecutive zero-trade days. Will auto-validate on next trade.
what_the_evidence_actually_shows.regime_detector: Regime lag is real but NOT the primary cause of missed trades. Even with perfect regime detection, SH/PSQ would score eff_conf=0.00 because the confidence formula has no component for inverse-ETF worthiness.
what_the_evidence_actually_shows.missed_opportunities: 5 of 7 today's winners WERE detected as candidates. They failed at confidence (eff_conf 0.00-0.20, gate=0.25). The scanner IS working — the confidence formula is the bottleneck.
what_the_evidence_actually_shows.connection_errors: All post-12:44 ET, all self-recovered, zero impact on trading
what_the_evidence_actually_shows.db_gap: Design gap, not bug. Organism and DB are parallel systems that were never connected.

investigation_items_for_later.title: Regime detector cross-session state contamination
investigation_items_for_later.detail: Smoothed regime probabilities persist across sessions. Consider resetting at session open.
investigation_items_for_later.timing: After 5+ more trading sessions of evidence

investigation_items_for_later.title: Confidence formula structural gap for inverse ETFs and defensive rotations
investigation_items_for_later.detail: The formula 0.65*breakout + 0.35*tension will ALWAYS produce near-zero for SH/PSQ/CRM-style moves. This is the root cause of the organism's inability to trade on sell-off days. Addressing this requires a strategy change (Phase C work).
investigation_items_for_later.timing: Requires design discussion, not a quick fix

investigation_items_for_later.title: COST liquidity gate uses share volume not dollar volume
investigation_items_for_later.detail: COST at ~$1000/share has adequate dollar liquidity but fails the 10,000 share/20-bar gate.

investigation_items_for_later.title: MAE calculation uses stop_loss proxy instead of actual worst price
investigation_items_for_later.detail: live_engine.py:3330 uses stop_loss distance, not true min-price tracking. Overstates MAE.
investigation_items_for_later.timing: After more trades accumulate for validation

exact_action_for_tomorrow: No changes. Keep all thresholds, universe, confidence formula, and configuration identical. The next trade that opens and closes will validate the forensic field wiring. Continue accumulating evidence for the structural issues identified.
confidence_in_recommendation: HIGH — zero blockers found, all issues are well-understood structural gaps, and 2 days of data cannot justify parameter changes
